persistence: local atomic V8 journals using existing AtomicV8Journal

OBSERV-001: validated sequence and stable record ids
AUD-001: module-private WeakMap state with non-exported commit path
canonical occurred_at instant covered by record hash
FINOPS-001: validated sequence and stable event ids

integrity_limit: SHA-256 chain is corruption/inconsistency detection, not authenticated tamper-proofing.
payload_limit: Platform objects such as URL, Date, Map, Set or Blob are rejected instead of being silently degraded by V8 serialization.
migration: NONE. Parallel adapter only until OLD-vs-NEW comparison and explicit promotion gates.
